script = '''import openpyxl
import json

SRC = "/workspace/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx"
OUT = "/workspace/testbed/data/confirmed_orders.xlsx"

# Read source workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC)
ws = wb.active

# Get all rows as lists
all_rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
    all_rows.append(list(row))

# Header is first row
header = all_rows[0]
data_rows = all_rows[1:]

print(f"Columns: {header}")
print(f"Total data rows: {len(data_rows)}")

# Find status column index
status_idx = None
for i, col_name in enumerate(header):
    if col_name and "status" in str(col_name).lower():
        status_idx = i
        break

if status_idx is None:
    print("ERROR: Could not find Status column!")
    exit(1)

print(f"Status column index: {status_idx} ('{header[status_idx]}')")

# Collect unique status values
statuses = set(str(row[status_idx]).strip().lower() for row in data_rows if row[status_idx])
print(f"Unique status values: {statuses}")

# Filter confirmed orders
confirmed = [row for row in data_rows if row[status_idx] and str(row[status_idx]).strip().lower() == "confirmed"]
print(f"Confirmed orders: {len(confirmed)}")

# Create output workbook
wb_out = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws_out = wb_out.active
ws_out.title = "Confirmed Orders"

# Write header
ws_out.append(header)

# Write confirmed rows
for row in confirmed:
    # Convert datetime objects to strings for clean output
    clean_row = []
    for val in row:
        if hasattr(val, 'strftime'):
            clean_row.append(val.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        else:
            clean_row.append(val)
    ws_out.append(clean_row)

wb_out.save(OUT)
print(f"\\nSaved {len(confirmed)} confirmed orders to: {OUT}")

# Print summary of confirmed orders
print("\\n=== Confirmed Orders ===")
print(f"{'Order ID':<14} {'Customer':<20} {'Date':<12} {'Items':<50} {'Total Paid':>10}")
print("-" * 110)
for row in confirmed:
    oid = str(row[0])
    cust = str(row[1])
    date = row[2].strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if hasattr(row[2], 'strftime') else str(row[2])
    items = str(row[4])
    total = str(row[5])
    print(f"{oid:<14} {cust:<20} {date:<12} {items:<50} {total:>10}")
'''
